43849271.article_content:
Future of OSL in Jeopardy
by Lance Albertson on Wed, Apr 30 2025
I am writing to inform you about a critical and time-sensitive situation facing the Open Source Lab. Over the past
several years, we have been operating at a deficit due to a decline in corporate donations. While OSUâs College of
Engineering (CoE) has generously filled this gap, recent changes in university funding have led to a significant
reduction in CoEâs budget. As a result, our current funding model is no longer sustainable and CoE needs to find ways
to cut programs.
Earlier this week, I was informed that unless we secure $250,000 in committed funds, the OSL will be forced to shut
down later this year. I have reached out to our largest corporate sponsor and they are working to increase their
support as we update our contract, but that still may not be enough.
For transparency, the $250,000 is broken down into the following roughly:
Staff pay $150k (60%) (1 staff)
Student pay $65k (26%) (8 students)
Other expenses $35k (14%)
Other expenses include items such as hardware, travel, subscription services and other miscellaneous expenses needed to
run the OSL day to day.
If any of you can assist or connect me with potential supporters, please reach out as soon as possible. I need to
provide leadership with an update on any funding changes by
Wednesday, May 14, 2025
. Please reach out directly via
donations@osuosl.org
if youâre able to help us make it through this difficult time.
The OSU Foundation is an IRS 501(c)(3) nonprofit corporation, which provides many donors a tax advantage. Please
contact the OSU Foundation directly if you have questions about your eligibility. You can donate directly to us by
visiting our
donation page
.
OSL provides hosting for over 500 Free and Open Source Projects from all over the world. Over the course of its 22-year
existence, the OSL has mentored over 130 students, many of whom have gone on to create their own companies and work
throughout the larger tech ecosystem.
Some notable milestones over the years include:
Provided hosting for Mozilla Firefox when they needed help in the early days and hosted the release of 1.0
Was the home of the Apache Software Foundation, Linux Foundation, Kernel.org, Mozilla for many years
Offers fast and reliable software mirroring for projects
Currently provides infrastructure hosting for projects such as Drupal, Gentoo Linux, Debian, Fedora, phpBB, OpenID,
Buildroot/Busybox, Inkscape, Cinc and many more!
Virtual machines for x86, aarch64 and ppc64le are used by many projects for CI and other hosted services
Additionally, the university has long-term plans to deprecate the data center where all of our hosting is currently
located. Much of the university hosting has been moved to the cloud or the state data center, and OSU lacks the funds
to replace the aging UPS/HVAC systems. I am actively seeking a new location to host our systems, but finding suitable
data center space on campus has proven to be extremely challenging.
To be clear: OSLâs immediate need is securing additional funding, the data center situation can be worked on later.
Your commitment is crucial for us to move forward. I am available to answer any questions you might have.
Thank you for your continued support!
Lance Albertson, Director
43849271.article_summary: 开放源代码实验室（OSL）正面临严峻的资金短缺，可能在2025年晚些时候关闭。由于企业捐赠减少，俄勒冈州立大学（OSU）工程学院（CoE）一直在资助OSL，但因大学预算削减，这一模式难以为继。OSL需要在5月14日前筹集25万美元，以维持运营，其中大部分资金用于支付员工和学生的工资以及其他日常开支。若无法筹集到这笔资金，实验室将被迫关闭。OSL为超过500个开源项目提供托管服务，并在其22年的历史中培养了130多名学生。此外，大学计划淘汰OSL目前使用的数据中心，而OSL缺乏资金更换老化的设备或寻找新的托管地点。当前最紧迫的任务是筹集资金，以确保实验室的持续运营。如能提供帮助，请联系donations@osuosl.org。

data.title: NYC home prices rise 10% in early 2025
data.author: geox
data.article_summary: 2025年初，纽约市房价同比上涨10%，曼哈顿引领增长，中位售价达$768,000。曼哈顿的Hudson Yards成为最贵社区，中位售价$5.355百万，其他如Little Italy、SoHo等也位列前五。皇后区的Malba中位售价最高，达$1.55百万，而布鲁克林的涨幅最大，尤其是Madison社区，中位售价暴涨145%至$1.25百万。布朗克斯的房价增长最慢，无一社区进入全市前50。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：纽约市房地产市场的价格变化及相关因素

不同观点：
• **[wdpk]** 认为文章标题具有误导性，全市范围内10%的中位数增长没有实际意义。不同社区的中位数价格差异很大，且不同类型的房产（如联排别墅、新开发楼盘、合作公寓等）价格差异显著。他指出，Carroll Gardens的中位价格减半只是因为某季度内销售的房产类型变化，而非整体价格下跌。
  
• **[GlibMonkeyDeath]** 强调房地产市场是本地化的，单个区域的趋势难以代表整体。对比了不同大都市区的房价，指出纽约市的房价虽上升10%，但仍低于洛杉矶/橙县和圣何塞/桑尼维尔。同时提到一些价格较低的城市如克利夫兰和布法罗。

• **[janalsncm]** 推测纽约市的房价趋势可能不会在整个上半年保持，并指出湾区房价也可能因市场波动下跌。他认为高收入人群的资产组合中股票比例较高，股市波动对高端房产市场影响更大。

• **[akoster]** 指出纽约市人口尚未恢复到2020年高点，但租金和房价仍在快速上涨。他提到原因包括临时住所、外国投资者、新建筑不足等，质疑为何人口减少和新建住宅增加未能降低价格。

• **[koolba]** 认为纽约市房价上涨符合逻辑，因为黄金和欧元等国际资产价格上涨，而纽约是国际化城市。

• **[affinepplan]** 认为当前的房价上涨不可持续且不应被接受，几乎所有社会问题都可以追溯到住房供应不足。

• **[ChrisLTD]** 表示纽约市房价仍在上涨，似乎尚未达到市场无法承受的极限。

• **[leflambeur]** 提出纽约市的房价涨幅可能高于美国其他地区，并通过个人观察指出南部郊区的房价自2020年以来上涨了70%，而纽约市的涨幅约为20%。

• **[vondur]** 提到富裕人群迁入纽约市推高了房价，导致中产阶级面临更多竞争。

• **[flerchin]** 指出达拉斯的房价从峰值下降了约10%。

• **[JCM9]** 认为尽管纽约市房价高昂，但相比西海岸仍有吸引力。纽约市在疫情后复苏强劲，许多人希望成为其中一员，且二套房市场强劲，拥有一套纽约市的房产是身份的象征。

• **[margorczynski]** 关注房价上涨是否超过通胀，并指出全球趋势是人口向大城市集中，乡村逐渐衰落。

• **[mupuff1234]** 好奇如果纽约市由新加坡管理会怎样。

• **[ldjkfkdsjnv]** 认为纽约市的租金也失控，但城市仍是地球上最好的地方。

• **[ramesh31]** 强烈建议在低哈德逊河谷购买房地产，认为该地区公共交通便利且房价相对可承受。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于纽约市房价上涨的原因及可持续性，部分评论者认为市场存在泡沫，而另一些人则认为纽约市的吸引力及国际资本流入将继续推高房价。
- 不同地区的房价对比（如纽约市与洛杉矶、达拉斯等）也是讨论重点，表明房地产市场高度本地化。
- 人口变化、新建筑完工与房价之间的关系复杂，评论者对此有不同解释。

43849791.article_content:
Real Estate
NYC home prices rise 10% in early 2025, with Manhattan leading and Malba ranking highest in Queens: report
By Ethan Marshall
Posted on
April 29, 2025
Manhattan accounted for the top five neighborhoods in New York City with the highest median sale price during the first quarter of 2025, according to a report from PropertyShark.
Photo via Getty Images
The median sale price across New York City rose 10% year-over-year in the first quarter of 2025, from around $698,000 last year to $768,000 this year, according to a
report
by the real estate database site
PropertyShark
. Several Manhattan neighborhoods had the most significant increases over this period of time among the boroughs included in the study (Staten Island is not included), from $999,000 in 2024 to $1.15 million in 2025.
Manhattan neighborhoods account for the five most expensive places in New York City during the first quarter of 2025. Hudson Yards is the most expensive place to live, with a median sale price of $5.355 million, followed by Little Italy at $4.593 million, SoHo at $3.85 million, TriBeCa at $3.3 million and Hudson Square at $2.6 million. Hudson Square also had the sharpest percentage jump in median sale price in the borough and the third-highest among the top 50 neighborhoods, with a 61% increase from $1.615 million last year.
Queens had very little growth in its median sale price compared to that of Manhattan. There was just a 6% increase in the World’s Borough, from $549,000 last year to $581,000 this year. There was still a strong presence of neighborhoods in the borough among the top 50 highest median sale prices in New York City, with 11 appearing on the list.
Malba
ranked the highest, at 11th overall with a median sale price of $1.55 million.
Close
Get the Full Story
News, events, culture and more — delivered to you.
Thank you for subscribing!
Email
Sign Up
Via Google Maps
Malba is a quiet, affluent neighborhood in northeastern Queens known for its large custom homes, tree-lined streets, and waterfront views. The neighborhood has been referred to as “the Hamptons of Queens.” It offers a suburban feel within New York City and consistently ranks among the borough’s most expensive areas.
East
Flushing
went through the biggest percentage boost in median sale price across the borough of Queens, at 51%, from $616,000 last year to $933 this year. This was also the fourth-highest leap among the top 50 neighborhoods across New York City. This drastic change was due in large part to much more houses being sold in the neighborhood, and at higher price points.
Brooklyn ended up having the most neighborhoods ranked among the 50 most expensive areas in New York City, with 22, edging out the 20 in Manhattan. The median sale price in the borough rose drastically, from $763,000 last year to $858,000 this year. Three of its neighborhoods were among the top ten with the highest median sale price. Cobble Hill was sixth, at $1.91 million, followed by DUMBO seventh at $1.878 million and Boerum Hill ninth at $1.695 million.
Brooklyn also had the top two neighborhoods with the most significant percentage increase in the median sale price. Madison led the way, with a 145% jump from $510,000 in 2024 to $1.25 million in 2025, followed by Mill Basin with a 62% increase from $878,000 to $1.425 million. The extreme surge in Madison was thanks in large part to houses accounting for 11 of the 15 transactions during this period, as opposed to less than half in the previous year.
The Bronx had the smallest increase in median sale price, from $315,000 in the first quarter of 2024 to $345,000 in the first quarter of 2025. This minor change is exemplified by the fact that not a single neighborhood in the borough ranked among the top 50 areas in New York City with the highest median sale price.
About the Author
Ethan Marshall
I was born and raised on Long Island and reside in Bayside. Graduated Cum Laude from Hofstra University. Big Mets, Jets and Islanders fan.

data.title: The Mira Pro Color is Boox's first color E Ink monitor
data.author: tortilla
data.article_summary: Boox推出了其首款25.3英寸彩色E Ink桌面显示器Mira Pro Color。该显示器采用与Kindle等电子阅读器相同的彩色E Ink屏幕技术，具有护眼优势，适合长时间使用。虽然其刷新率无法与LCD或OLED屏幕相比，但Boox提供了四种可自定义的显示模式，使其足够快以播放视频。该显示器更适合文字编辑、写作或处理电子表格等生产力任务，而非游戏或视频编辑。Mira Pro Color配备前光和色温调节功能，并有HDMI、USB-C和DisplayPort等多种接口。不过，由于E Ink面板成本高，其价格为1,899.99美元，且从中国发货可能涉及关税。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：E-ink显示器的优缺点及市场定位

不同观点：
• CobaltFire：分享了使用Bigme B251 E-ink显示器的经验。尽管刷新慢、色彩饱和度低、有残影，但非常适合文本相关的任务。推荐在Amazon购买，因为可能存在面板质量问题，Amazon的退货政策有保障。同时推荐MacOS用户使用stillcolor软件。

• seam_carver：喜欢E-ink屏幕，尤其是相比传统LCD屏幕，视觉体验更舒适。虽然他使用的是更便宜的E-ink手机，但认为E-ink屏幕在各种设备上都有吸引力。
• CommieBobDole：质疑E-ink显示器作为高价桌面显示器的市场定位。指出其4096色和缓慢的刷新率是否足以支持一般桌面应用，并怀疑其是否适合作为日常显示器。
• gibibit：预测E-ink显示器不会广泛流行。认为E-ink更适合便携式阅读设备，而非桌面大屏。强调其刷新率慢、寿命有限等问题。
• enescakir：希望Daylight团队能推出更好的E-ink显示器，认为目前的Mira Pro虽然是首创但仍显不足。
• izzydata：对Kobo Clara Color的显示效果表示满意，但认为E-ink显示器需要更快的刷新率和更低的价格才能被广泛接受。
• throwaway74354：提醒用户Boox公司常有GPL违规行为。
• mystified5016：建议可以通过无线或有线方式实现全分辨率E-ink显示器的无线传输，认为便携式无线E-ink显示器将非常实用。

补充讨论：
• 价格问题被techpineapple提出，强调高价E-ink显示器的非 starter性质。
• 讨论中涉及多个具体产品如Bigme B251、Mudita Kompakt、Kobo Clara Color和Mira Pro，用户对它们的功能和价格进行了比较和评价。
• 争议焦点主要在于E-ink显示器的市场定位和实用性，尤其是其刷新率和色彩表现是否足以支持日常使用，以及其高昂的价格是否合理。

总结：用户对E-ink显示器的文本显示效果普遍认可，但对其刷新率、色彩表现和价格有较多质疑。争议点集中在E-ink显示器的市场定位和是否能满足日常使用需求。

Boox has upgrade its Mira Pro E Ink monitor with the same color screen technology found in e-readers.
Image: Boox
Andrew Liszewski
is a senior reporter who’s been covering and reviewing the latest gadgets and tech since 2011, but has loved all things electronic since he was a kid.
Boox is debuting its
first desktop monitor featuring a color E Ink screen
. The new version of the Boox Mira Pro carries over the same functionality as the black-and-white version that launched in 2023, but using the same E Ink color display technology found in devices like the
Kindle Colorsoft
.
E Ink offers several advantages to display technologies like LCD and OLED, including a screen that reflects light instead of emitting it, so it’s potentially easier on the eyes for prolonged use. Still, large E Ink panels are expensive. The Mira Pro Color is only 25.3-inches in size but is priced at $1,899.99. Boox also says its Mira Series of E Ink monitors only ship from China and “some countries may levy tariffs on the imported goods.” If you’re having one shipped to the US, it could cost you a lot more.
The Mira Pro Color monitor has a display mode fast enough to watch videos, but the display is better suited to productivity tasks like writing or spreadsheets.
Image: Boox
While devices like the
Remarkable Paper Pro
use E Ink’s more advanced Gallery 3 screen technology that can display over 50,000 colors, its slow refresh rate makes it problematic for desktop computing tasks like browsing the web. The Mira Pro Color instead uses a 3,200 x 1,800 E Ink Kaleido 3 panel that can only display a limited palette of 4,096 different colors. Its refresh capabilities also can’t match the best LCD or OLED screens, but Boox offers four customizable display modes balancing image quality and performance that’s fast enough to watch videos.
The Mira Pro Color features front lighting similar to what’s found in e-readers with the option to adjust the color temperature to warmer hues at night. It’s also got a pair of speakers, a dedicated refresh button on the side to remove ghosting, and five ports including HDMI, mini HDMI, USB-C, and DisplayPort.
If you’re a gamer, photo or video editor, or someone who uses their desktop monitor for watching TV and movies, the Mira Pro Color isn’t for you. But if you spend your days editing text, writing, or crunching numbers in spreadsheets in a space with plenty of light, an E Ink monitor might be worth considering, particularly if you find yourself frequently dealing with eye strain.

data.title: Doom GPU Flame Graphs
data.author: LorenDB
data.article_summary: Brendan Gregg的博客介绍了多个系统性能分析工具和方法，包括火焰图、FlameScope、USE方法、TSA方法等。最近的文章聚焦于GPU和AI火焰图的更新，特别提到新增的Intel Battlemage GPU支持，可以生成全栈GPU火焰图，帮助分析游戏性能问题。通过将CPU和GPU火焰图并排对比，可以直观地进行性能关联分析。文章以GZDoom游戏为例，展示了如何利用FlameScope工具点击特定时间段生成火焰图，从而识别CPU和GPU的性能瓶颈。例如，分析显示GPU的停滞主要来自渲染、后处理效果、模版以及精灵处理等不同部分。文章还提到通过调整游戏地图和GPU资源限制，进一步测试和分析性能问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同工具和开发进展在AI和系统性能分析中的潜在竞争优势

不同观点：
• anitil认为文中提到的发展非常有趣，特别是结合去年的相关文章以及与Nvidia的比较，指出像Brendan Gregg团队开发的工具可能会为Intel带来竞争优势。该评论者表示虽然觉得这个发展很有趣，但还不能完全明确其吸引力所在。
• petermcneeley则表示Magic Trace工具（由Jane Street开发）更有用，并提供了一个GitHub链接，暗示Magic Trace在实际应用中可能比文章中讨论的工具更为有效。

补充讨论：
• anitil提到了两个参考链接，一个是关于AI火焰图的 companion文章，另一个是关于Nvidia可用资源较少的讨论，表明他对比了不同公司和工具之间的发展。
• petermcneeley的评论引入了Magic Trace作为一个实际可用的工具选项，提出了另一种在性能分析中可能更有效的工具，从而引发了对不同工具相对优点的讨论。

争议焦点：
• 争议的焦点在于哪种工具（Brendan Gregg团队的工具还是Magic Trace）在实际应用中能提供更大的竞争优势和实用性。anitil对Intel可能获得的竞争优势持积极态度，而petermcneeley则通过推荐Magic Trace暗示了另一种可能更优的选择。

Doom GPU Flame Graphs
01 May 2025
AI Flame Graphs
are now
open source
and include Intel Battlemage GPU support, which means it can also generate full-stack GPU flame graphs for providing new insights into gaming performance, especially when coupled with
FlameScope
(an older open source project of mine). Here's an example of GZDoom, and I'll start with flame scopes for both CPU and GPU utilization, with details annotated:
(Here are the raw
CPU
and
GPU
versions.) FlameScope shows a subsecond-offset heatmap of profile samples, where each column is one second (in this example, made up of 50 x 20ms blocks) and the color depth represents the number of samples, revealing variance and perturbation that you can select to generate a flame graph just for that time range.
Putting these CPU and GPU flame scopes side by side has enabled your eyes to do pattern matching to solve what would otherwise be a time-consuming task of performance correlation. The gaps in the GPU flame scope on the right – where the GPU was not doing much work – match the heavier periods of CPU work on the left.
CPU Analysis
FlameScope lets us click on the interesting periods. By selecting one of the CPU shader compilation stripes we get the flame graph just for that range:
This is brilliant, and we can see exactly why the CPUs were busy for about 180 ms (the vertical length of the red stripe): it's doing compilation of GPU shaders and some NIR preprocessing (optimizations to the
NIR intermediate representation
that Mesa uses internally). If you are new to flame graphs, you look for the widest towers and optimize them first. Here is the
interactive SVG
.
CPU flame graphs and CPU flame scope aren't new (from
2011
and
2018
, both open source). What is new is full-stack
GPU
flame graphs and
GPU
flame scope.
GPU Analysis
Interesting details can also be selected in the GPU FlameScope for generating GPU flame graphs.
This example selects the "room 3" range, which is a room in the Doom map that contains hundreds of enemies.
The
green
frames are the actual instructions running on the GPU,
aqua
shows the source for these functions, and
red
(C) and
yellow
(C++) show the CPU code paths that initiated the GPU programs. The
gray
"-" frames just help highlight the boundary between CPU and GPU code. (This is similar to what I described in the
AI flame graphs
post, which included extra frames for kernel code.) The x-axis is proportional to cost, so you look for the widest things and find ways to reduce them.
I've included the
interactive SVG
version of this flame graph so you can mouse-over elements and click to zoom. (
PNG
version.)
The GPU flame graph is split between stalls coming from rendering walls (41.4%), postprocessing effects (35.7%), stenciling (17.2%), and sprites (4.95%). The CPU stacks are further differentiated by the individual shaders that are causing stalls, along with the reasons for those stalls.
GZDoom
We picked
GZDoom
to try since it's an open source version of a well known game that runs on Linux (our profiler does not support Windows yet). Intel Battlemage makes light work of GZDoom, however, and since the GPU profile is stall-based we weren't getting many samples. We could have switched to a more modern and GPU-demanding game, but didn't have any great open source ideas, so I figured we'd just make GZDoom more demanding. We built GPU demanding maps for GZDoom (I can't believe I have found a work-related reason to be using
Slade
), and also set some Battlemage tunables to limit resources, magnifying the utilization of remaining resources.
Our GZDoom test map has three rooms: room 1 is empty, room 2 is filled with tor

data.title: Elon Musk Just Doesn't Understand the Sci-Fi Visions of Iain M. Banks
data.author: mitchbob
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了埃隆·马斯克对已故科幻作家伊恩·M·班克斯（Iain M. Banks）作品的误读。马斯克曾自称是“乌托邦无政府主义者”，类似于班克斯在其“文化”系列小说中描绘的社会。尽管马斯克对班克斯表示赞赏，并以班克斯的作品命名SpaceX飞船，但他可能并未真正理解作品的深层含义。班克斯的“文化”系列描绘了一个复杂、多元的星际文明，涵盖广泛的政治和社会议题，如性别流动性、无政府主义和乌托邦理想。文章指出，马斯克似乎只关注乌托邦式的太空文明，而忽略了其中的复杂性和批判性。作者强调，这并非出于政治分歧，而是因为马斯克未能深入理解班克斯作品中的深刻思想和社会批判。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对Iain Banks所描绘的未来乐观愿景的解读，以及其与现实人物如Elon Musk的对比和关联

不同观点：
• [lacker] 认为Banks对未来的设想是宏大且乐观的，尤其是关于太空旅行、人工智能和接近永生的设想。这种愿景不需要在每个具体政治立场上都达成一致也能被欣赏。

• [0_gravitas] 指出Banks在作品中通常并不掩饰自己的信念和他所认为的“好人”。尽管作品中探讨了灰色地带和非人性，提出了对社会严肃的质疑，但Banks本人曾表示愿意生活在Culture世界中，即使接受其丑陋部分。这表明Banks对其设想的未来世界持有积极态度。

• [simpaticoder] 对Banks的论点持怀疑态度，引用“人类是数字超级智能的生物引导程序”这一观点，认为像Musk这样的人如果相信这一点，他们的当前行动就只在于是否有助于数字超级智能的诞生。这种观点类似于“结果 justify 手段”的逻辑，无法在短期内对行动的成功与否进行客观评估，从而可能导致自私和破坏性行为。

• [jiggawatts] 认为Culture小说中的核心主题是，在存在超人类人工智能的世界中，人类只是宠物。任何希望这种未来的人实际上是希望成为宠物。

• [theothertimcook] 自称为Iain Banks所描述的乌托邦无政府主义者，认同Banks的理想社会形态。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于对Banks未来设想的解读以及其与现实中人物如Musk的理念对比。一部分人欣赏Banks的乐观未来愿景，另一部分人则担心这种愿景在现实中的应用可能导致负面后果，如自私行为或对个体幸福的忽视。

• Banks作品中对人性和人工智能关系的探讨也是讨论的一个重要方面，尤其是人类在未来社会中地位的变化。

Elon Musk Just Doesn’t Understand the Sci-Fi Visions of Iain M. Banks
Tobias Carroll on When Bad Fans Happen to Good Books
By
Tobias Carroll
April 30, 2025
In June of 2018, before he declared himself “Dark MAGA” and before he wore a hat with the inscription “Trump Was Right About Everything,” Elon Musk took to a social media platform he did not yet own to describe his own politics. “If you must know, I am a utopian anarchist of the kind best described by Iain Banks,” Musk
wrote
on the site then known as Twitter, prompting
The Guardian
’s Stuart Kelly to wryly
ask
, “[H]as Musk actually read any of Banks’s books?”
Besides the approving nods on social media, Musk has named several SpaceX craft in
homage
to sentient vessels in Banks’s Culture cycle of novels and stories. But even if Musk has read Banks’s books, it’s less than clear if he’s taken the right lessons from them. There’s a lot that’s been written in the last decade about what the writer Emily Nussbaum
called
“bad fans”—a brigade that also includes a certain
head of state
to whom Musk has grown close in the last year. And when it comes to Musk and Banks, the former being a bad fan of the latter is arguably the best case scenario.
Banks, who died in 2013 at the age of 59, wrote in a wide range of styles;
The Crow Road
is a moving coming-of-age story, while the Gothic-infused
The Wasp Factory
features a scene so horrific I nearly threw the book across the room the first time I read it. He was also held deeply political convictions; his nonfiction book
Raw Spirit
begins with Banks destroying his passport to protest the invasion of Iraq in 2003.
It’s the Culture series for which Banks is best known, however; a group of novels and stories set across the galaxy. There is no overarching story here; a handful of characters turn up in multiple works, but the books themselves stand alone. Ursula K. Le Guin’s Hainish Cycle is a good comparison, both in terms of the granular level of storytelling and for the way you can see an author using science fiction to grapple with big sociopolitical ideas. Or, as the narration in 1987’s
Consider Phlebas
phrases it, the Culture is a “seemingly disunited, anarchic, hedonistic, decadent mélange of more or less human species.”
The Culture books vary wildly in tone and structure.
Use of Weapons
is a kind of espionage thriller surrounding a formally inventive series of flashbacks that concludes with an utterly harrowing moment that spins the whole narrative around;
The Hydrogen Sonata
and
The Player of Games
focus on solitary characters pursuing their own aesthetic or artistic ambitions.
Surface Detail
is both a thrilling space opera and a study of metaphysics;
Consider Phlebas
and
Matter
both get plenty of mileage by showing readers the Culture from the perspective of someone raised outside of that society. It’s a lot; it also accomplishes the difficult task of abounding with big ideas even as it’s also gripping on the sentence-to-sentence level. It’s not for nothing that Banks was named one of
Granta
’s
Best Young British Novelists
in 1993, after all.
It’s as though Musk grew so attached to the idea of a utopian spacefaring civilization that he never bothered to look too deeply into the inner workings of that civilization.
Before going deeper into Banks’s Culture books, it seems worthwhile to address one point: I don’t mean to argue that Musk’s fondness for Banks is flawed along partisan or ideological lines. I myself have read and enjoyed the work of plenty of
authors
with whom I disagree politically. Musk’s fondness for Banks’s work feels more dissonant than that. It’s as though he grew so attached to the idea of a utopian spacefaring civilization that he never bothered to look too deeply into the inner workings of that civilization.
Let’s get the biggest one out of the way: the Culture is a society where a significant number of its inhabitants are genderfluid. Here’s a description of one of the characters in 2008’s
Matter
:
Jerle Batra had been born male. He had, as was common in the Culture, changed sex a while, and had borne a child.
43848603.article_summary: 本文探讨了埃隆·马斯克对已故科幻作家伊恩·M·班克斯（Iain M. Banks）作品的误读。马斯克曾自称是“乌托邦无政府主义者”，类似于班克斯在其“文化”系列小说中描绘的社会。尽管马斯克对班克斯表示赞赏，并以班克斯的作品命名SpaceX飞船，但他可能并未真正理解作品的深层含义。班克斯的“文化”系列描绘了一个复杂、多元的星际文明，涵盖广泛的政治和社会议题，如性别流动性、无政府主义和乌托邦理想。文章指出，马斯克似乎只关注乌托邦式的太空文明，而忽略了其中的复杂性和批判性。作者强调，这并非出于政治分歧，而是因为马斯克未能深入理解班克斯作品中的深刻思想和社会批判。

data.article_summary: 文章讲述了Janet Jackson的歌曲《Rhythm Nation》因其低音线频率问题，曾在2005年后的某些笔记本电脑上引发系统崩溃的现象。具体来说，这首歌的某些频率与5400转硬盘的共振频率吻合，导致硬盘振动过大，最终引发操作系统崩溃。微软为此在Windows XP中加入了数字信号处理器代码来过滤这些频率，直到Windows 7发布后才取消。尽管问题得到了处理，但一些笔记本厂商仍可能受到此问题的影响。这一技术漏洞成为了当时的一个奇特现象。

43848892.article_content:
(Image credit: Janet Jackson, A&M Records, Vevo)
In a recent campaign of TTRPG City of Mist, I played a world-weary lounge singer increasingly finding the watery despair captured in the poem
Lorelei
was sending unwelcome ripples through her life. Perhaps needless to say, the idea of a songstress who harbours a voice with devastating power is a creative idea I find extremely compelling. So when I caught wind of a song with the power to crash laptops, I knew I had to dive deeper.
It sounds like an urban legend but for years vendors of certain laptop models would quake in fear over a particular melody:
Rhythm Nation by Janet Jackson
. Once upon a time, playing this 1989 banger through certain laptop speakers wouldn't just crash that specific laptop, but could also temporarily compromise nearby laptops from different manufacturers within shoulder-shimmying, head-bobbing distance. Jacob wrote about it
when this bizarre tech vulnerability first came to light
, but now we know that this absolute belter was a cursed melody to some laptop vendors for half a decade (via
PC World
).
The story originally surfaced second-hand in a
2022 blog post from Raymond Chen
, explaining that after a great deal of testing, the cause of the crashes was isolated to the sound of the song itself. It turns out 1989's Rhythm Nation harbours the resonant frequency for components within 5,400 RPM hard drives, causing the moving parts of the hard drive to vibrate in arcs that would gradually sweep wider than intended. Ultimately, sustained exposure to the resonant frequency created enough read errors to crash some laptops' operating systems—David Plummer, another Microsoft alumnus,
breaks down how this works in his own retelling of the story
.

As for what specific part of the song is doing the laptop crashing,
Chen's follow-up post
points to a
brilliant musical analysis by Adam Neely
; to summarise in a few words from someone who is definitely
not
a music theorist, Rhythm Nation's bassline is just that powerful, with a resonant peak of about 84.2 Hz.
Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE)
describes the issue as affecting laptops and PCs from "approximately 2005 and later." To combat it, Microsoft wrote some Digital Signal Processor code to effectively filter out the offending frequencies on Windows XP machines. To be clear, this wasn't a bit of code specifically targeting Jackson's optimistic bop about the uniting power of music, but a notch filter intended to prevent speakers from playing all instances of the laptop crashing resonant frequency.
So, how long was that bit of code in effect? Well,
Chen wrote one more followup blog this month
that revealed the filter was still present until at least the launch of Windows 7 in 2009. At this time, Microsoft imposed a new rule requiring that users must have the option to disable Audio Processing Objects (APOs)—like the aforementioned frequency filtering code. That's about half a decade of Microsoft and laptop vendors attempting to circumvent Rhythm Nation-induced crashes.
The vendor of the primarily affected laptops applied for an exception, fearing that the bounce back of the bass might not just physically damage their products but also their reputation. On these grounds, the exemption was granted—meaning that out there somewhere a vendor of HDD laptops may still be haunted by the incredible bassline of Rhythm Nation.

data.title: Shoes on at home or shoes off? If you care about your health, it's a no-brainer
data.author: n1b0m
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了在家是否应该脱鞋的问题。作者引用研究指出，96%的鞋子携带粪便中的大肠菌群，以及其他细菌和有毒化学物质，可能导致健康问题。尽管有科学证据支持脱鞋的好处，但在英国，要求客人脱鞋常被认为是不酷且过于拘谨的行为。文章还提到，一些家庭想成为"脱鞋家庭"，但担心给人留下过于严肃的印象。作者建议，需要一个被普遍喜爱的公众人物来重新塑造脱鞋家庭的形象，使其显得有趣且放松。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：是否应该脱鞋以及脱鞋的卫生和文化影响

不同观点：
• [m463] 担心脱鞋会导致足癣等卫生问题，特别是如果每个人都脱鞋的话。
• [john-h-k] 以幽默方式回应，表示自己即使在进行地板清洁时也会确保让大家脱鞋，暗示脱鞋是种清洁习惯。
• [rendx] 支持脱鞋，认为脱鞋对足部健康有益，可以让脚“呼吸”并感到更加接地气，强调个人舒适感。
• [jdboyd] 认为脱鞋未必更干净，特别是在有宠物（如猫狗）的家庭，因为宠物可能带来额外的卫生问题。
• [RetroTeche] 提出鞋底的细菌不一定让人生病，甚至少量的细菌可能对健康有益，质疑过度强调脱鞋的卫生理由。
• [an_aparallel] 认为脱鞋与否是文化差异（如中东/亚洲习惯脱鞋，而英美习惯穿鞋），同时指出公共场所的卫生问题，强调基本的卫生习惯是必要的。
• [AStoneThrow] 分享个人经验，说明自己因为生活习惯和租房原因，逐渐养成了脱鞋的习惯，但伴侣（来自不同文化背景）对此感到震惊并坚持要穿拖鞋，特别是由于宠物可能带来的卫生问题。

补充讨论：
• 文化差异在脱鞋习惯中的影响：例如中东和亚洲文化通常习惯脱鞋，而英美文化则更多保持穿鞋。
• 个人习惯与家庭规则的冲突：例如有人习惯脱鞋，但在伴侣或客人面前可能需要调整。
• 宠物对脱鞋习惯的影响：宠物可能带来的卫生问题（如猫的毛发或排泄物）是反对脱鞋的一个重要论据。
• 卫生与免疫力之间的平衡：有人认为少量接触外界细菌可能有助于增强免疫力，但基本的卫生仍需维持。

争议焦点：
• 脱鞋是否真的更卫生：有人认为脱鞋能减少外界细菌带入室内，但也有人指出室内宠物等问题同样带来卫生挑战，脱鞋未必能解决问题。

‘Can you be a Shoes Off household while avoiding Shoes Off household energy?’
Photograph: Jana Richter/Getty Images
View image in fullscreen
‘Can you be a Shoes Off household while avoiding Shoes Off household energy?’
Photograph: Jana Richter/Getty Images
Opinion
Homes
Shoes on at home or shoes off? If you care about your health, it’s a no-brainer
Polly Hudson
One study reported that 96% of shoes carry coliform bacteria, commonly found in faecal matter. So why is it so uncool to ask visitors to take them off?
Wed 30 Apr 2025 10.52 EDT
Last modified on Wed 30 Apr 2025 13.06 EDT
Share
I
t is a truth almost universally unacknowledged in the UK that wearing shoes in the home is gross. More than gross, actually – there’s scientific evidence it could have serious health consequences and even, if you want to come over all dramatic about it, be life-threatening. And yet I can count on the fingers of no hands the people I know who ask me to remove my shoes when I visit.
Until now this has been an uncomplicatedly divisive subject: you were either a Shoes Off household, or you weren’t. But a secret underground movement is gathering pace – the Shoes On households who wish they were Shoes Off, but are worried about the uptight implications of rolling out that policy. Can you be a Shoes Off household while avoiding Shoes Off household energy?
The Shoes Off brigade get a bad rap, given that they’re essentially right – outdoor shoes carry bacteria, allergens and toxic chemicals that could lead to
E coli
, MRSA or various deadly bloodstream infections. You’re glazing over, aren’t you? Maybe this will grab your attention: 96% of shoes tested positive for coliform bacteria, which is commonly found in faecal matter, in a
University of Arizona study
. Everyone will presumably now try to convince themselves they’re in the 4% club but although maths is far from my strong point, I’m fairly sure we can’t all be. In other words, we’d apparently rather let our friends track crap all over our homes than demand they go shoe-free, because that seems so control-freaky and joyless.
The other problem with Shoes Off households is that most of them don’t give you advance warning, meaning you could end up barefoot in public without the maintenance essential for that to be a mutually non-horrifying experience – or wearing your worst socks. Your shoes might be the key element that ties your whole look together, so you’re a fashion disaster without them. Also, Shoes Off households can’t win with their implementation methods. If they offer communal slippers, yuck. If they don’t, eeek.
What Shoes Off households need is a rebrand, for somebody seen as fun and relaxed, but trustworthy, to out themselves as one of them. It’s a tall order, because it would have to be exactly the right person, universally adored, no less than national treasure status for sure. No pressure, Olivia Colman, but our lives are in your hands.
Polly Hudson is a freelance writer

• [an_aparallel] 认为脱鞋与否是文化差异（如中东/亚洲习惯脱鞋，而英美习惯穿鞋），同时指出公共场所的卫生问题，强调基本的卫生习惯是必要的。
• [AStoneThrow] 分享个人经验，说明自己因为生活习惯和租房原因，逐渐养成了脱鞋的习惯，但伴侣（来自不同文化背景）对此感到震惊并坚持要穿拖鞋，特别是由于宠物可能带来的卫生问题。

补充讨论：
• 文化差异在脱鞋习惯中的影响：例如中东和亚洲文化通常习惯脱鞋，而英美文化则更多保持穿鞋。
• 个人习惯与家庭规则的冲突：例如有人习惯脱鞋，但在伴侣或客人面前可能需要调整。
• 宠物对脱鞋习惯的影响：宠物可能带来的卫生问题（如猫的毛发或排泄物）是反对脱鞋的一个重要论据。
• 卫生与免疫力之间的平衡：有人认为少量接触外界细菌可能有助于增强免疫力，但基本的卫生仍需维持。

争议焦点：
• 脱鞋是否真的更卫生：有人认为脱鞋能减少外界细菌带入室内，但也有人指出室内宠物等问题同样带来卫生挑战，脱鞋未必能解决问题。

data.article_summary: 本文介绍了对Ladybird浏览器引擎中的JavaScript引擎LibJS进行漏洞研究的过程。Ladybird是SerenityOS项目中的一个新浏览器引擎，目前处于pre-alpha阶段。LibJS目前只有解释器层，尚未有编译层，但包含一些现代JS引擎的优化。作者使用Fuzzilli对LibJS进行模糊测试，经过约10天测试，发现了10个独特崩溃。大多数问题较为普通，如验证失败、堆栈耗尽等，但也有一些有趣的漏洞，包括正则表达式解析器中的缓存问题和TypedArray中的整数溢出。最具利用潜力的是一个堆使用后释放（UAF）漏洞，发生在解释器的参数缓冲区，通过代理函数对象作为构造函数并结合恶意[[Get]]处理器触发。虽然某些漏洞难以复现或利用，但这一UAF漏洞具有较高的利用价值。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Ladybird浏览器的安全性和内存管理问题，以及从零构建浏览器时的设计选择和安全考量。

不同观点：
• awesomekling认为Ladybird的代码库防御性较强，但在JavaScript引擎中为了性能而有所妥协。他们采取了诸如用栈内存替代堆内存分配、更多使用垃圾回收等措施来解决内存管理问题。同时提到沙盒和站点隔离技术会进一步减少渲染器漏洞的危害。

• LegionMammal978指出重入性（reentrancy）漏洞很常见，尤其是在使用不安全代码（如Rust中的不安全块）时。解决方案包括限制可能失效的数据持有方式，或使用类似“纯函数”注解的机制来确保调用的函数不会影响数据。

• cadamsdotcom认为Ladybird能成为安全研究的目标是一个重要的里程碑，表明其在安全性研究中具有一定地位。

• neilv认为在全新开发的项目中，应该从设计和编码阶段就重视正确性和安全性，而不是仅仅依赖模糊测试（fuzzing）来检测问题。并提到Chrome和Firefox的频繁安全漏洞，希望Ladybird能避免类似问题。

• gitroom表示欣赏从零开始构建浏览器的做法，但质疑前期对安全的关注是否对长期效果有帮助，同时也担心过于注重趣味性可能导致忽略关键问题。

• qiu3344和讨论主题关系不大，仅表达了对过时技术（如dwm）的感慨。

• snvzz认为Ladybird在沙盒技术上尚未成熟，但仍认为其具有一定的学术价值。

• kavefish对选择C++作为2018年全新浏览器开发的语言表示质疑，认为在已有大量内存安全教训的背景下，选择更安全的语言会更合适。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是C++作为开发语言的选择是否合适，以及在项目初期是否应更注重安全性和正确性。
• 另一个焦点是如何有效避免重入性漏洞等常见安全问题，尤其是在使用不安全语言或不安全代码块时。
• 对Ladybird当前缺乏沙盒技术的关注，以及对未来改进的期望。

43852096.article_content:
Pwning the Ladybird browser
April 23, 2025
Intro
Ladybird
is a relatively new browser engine originating from the
SerenityOS project
. Currently, it’s in pre-alpha and improving quickly.
Take a look at the website and the GitHub for more information!
I’ll be researching the JavaScript engine of Ladybird,
LibJS
.
Architecture
LibJS has an interpreter tier and no compilation tiers (yet!). It includes common modern JS engine
optimizations and is built with extensive verification checks across its critical code paths and data
structures, including vectors, making scenarios such as integer overflows leading to out-of-bounds
accesses harder to exploit.
Fuzzing
We’ll be using Fuzzilli, a popular fuzzer for JavaScript interpreters. Here’s the description from the GitHub:
A (coverage-)guided fuzzer for dynamic language interpreters based on a custom
intermediate language ("FuzzIL") which can be mutated and translated to JavaScript.
-
Fuzzilli
Fuzzilli can be configured with additional code generators that can be specialized to trigger
specific bugs. LibJS isn’t actively being OSS-fuzzed, so I didn’t add any custom generators and hoped
there would be enough shallow bugs around. There was already some persistent fuzzing code
in LibJS. After some work — like needing to compile and link Skia with RTTI (Nix 💜), fixing
some build scripts, and compiling Fuzzilli with an additional profile (again, Nix was great for this) — I
got it all working!
I ran the fuzzer for ~10 days and found 10 unique crashes. A lot of the bugs were boring:
Verification failure
Stack exhaustion
OOM bugs
Bad bytecode generation
.
There were a few bugs that were more interesting:
A caching bug in the regex parser
An integer overflow in
TypedArray
Initially, I thought the regex bug was an integer overflow… unfortunately, it wasn’t. The real integer overflow
in
TypedArray
looked really promising — but it seems hard to exploit, with all the bounds checks protecting
vectors from bad accesses.
There were three bugs that looked really good: a heap buffer overflow, freelist corruption (or UAF) in the garbage
collector, and a heap use-after-free (UAF) in the malloc heap. But unfortunately, only the last UAF was reproducible outside of Fuzzilli.
I'm still not sure why the others didn't reproduce.
This
is the crash report for the
heap buffer overflow, and
this
is the one for the freelist corruption,
if interested.

A Vulnerable Function
The bug is a use-after-free (UAF) on the interpreter’s argument buffer. It’s triggered by using a
proxied function object as a constructor, together with a malicious
[[Get]]
handler.

() {}
new
Construct
();

here
.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI编码工具的速度与准确性、价格、技术实现及应用场景

不同观点：
• 一些人认为速度不能牺牲准确性。例如，inerte提到虽然等待AI代理完成工作很无聊，但经过一次复杂但错误的结果后，更倾向于使用准确但较慢的模型。然而，inerte也表示速度快的模型可能开启新的工具使用方式。
• dmos62关注模型的性能和命名问题，质疑Mercury Coder Small是否适合用于编码，因为它的智能水平更适合结构化数据提取和基本总结。
• schappim从价格角度出发，认为在需要高速度的场景（如高频交易、转录服务）中，Mercury可能具有市场优势，但目前的价格相对于竞争对手（如Gemini）并不占优。
• g-mork提到开源社区中也有类似的尝试，并暗示可能存在更强的竞争对手。
• jonplackett通过一个具体问题（冷却咖啡杯）测试Mercury，发现它能正确解答，而ChatGPT 4o不能，认为这显示了Mercury的强大。

补充讨论：
• freeqaz提到无法查看技术报告，质疑该团队的透明度。
• m-hodges指出Mercury在解决MU Puzzle时违反了规则，质疑其逻辑推理能力。
• jtonz认为Mercury在快速迭代生成解决方案方面有优势，可以减少人工干预和迭代次数。
• mlsu提到链式思考技术似乎只能在自回归架构中实现，质疑Mercury是否具备此能力。
• jakeinsdca实际测试后，认为Mercury在生成特定代码时比ChatGPT更快、更容易使用。
• parsimo2010认为尽管速度快，但当前文本生成领域的趋势（如推理能力）可能不会直接适用于Mercury，且其需要追赶现有最先进模型。
• stats111指出Mercury与一家银行同名，可能引发混淆。
• badmonster对Mercury的速度表示赞赏，特别是在不需要特殊硬件的情况下。
• jph00认为Mercury的定价高于最新Gemini模型，但只与旧模型进行了对比，质疑其市场定位。
• strangescript认为速度重要，但不能仅与旧模型对比，应该设定更高标准。

争议焦点：
• 速度与准确性的权衡：inerte、dmos62等对速度和准确性之间的权衡存在不同看法。
• 模型的实际应用能力：jonplackett通过具体例子称赞Mercury，而m-hodges通过逻辑问题质疑其能力。
• 定价与市场竞争力：schappim、jph00等质疑Mercury的价格相对于竞争对手是否合理。

总的来说，讨论围绕Mercury模型的速度、准确性、价格及其实际应用价值展开，各方对该技术的潜力及当前局限性有不同看法。

data.author: darpank
data.article_summary: GroMo举办FinArva AI Hackathon 2025，邀请产品、技术、商业和AI爱好者参与解决印度金融分销难题。获胜者有机会获得与创始人直接面试，年薪最高可达25万印度卢比，甚至40万卢比（针对有经验的专业人士）。比赛分为两个阶段：第一阶段是虚拟创意提交，关注GroMo合作伙伴的挑战；第二阶段是现场黑客马拉松，进行产品构建和展示。团队规模为3-5人，参赛者包括大学生、在职专业人士和AI爱好者。提交的解决方案需深入理解问题、创新、具有商业影响力、有效使用AI，并简易可扩展。获奖者可获得现金奖励、礼品和职业发展机会。报名链接和详细信息见文章。

data.title: Office is too slow, so Microsoft is making it load at Windows startup
data.author: airstrike
data.article_summary: 微软将为Office引入一个名为“Startup Boost”的功能，使Office在电脑启动时自动加载，以提升Word和Excel等应用的启动速度。虽然这可能让其他电脑操作变慢，但该功能仅在拥有至少8GB内存和5GB空闲磁盘空间的电脑上启用。初期的更新将仅影响Microsoft Word，并于五月中旬推出，之后扩展至其他Office程序。用户可以在设置中关闭此功能。尽管此举旨在提高性能，但一些用户质疑为何不直接优化Office本身的效率。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：微软Office软件的用户体验问题，包括其臃肿的体积、启动速度慢以及强制推送功能（如CoPilot图标）对用户体验的影响。

不同观点：
• [mrandish] 认为Office越来越臃肿，启动慢，且强制推送的CoPilot图标非常烦人，无法关闭。他表示即使作为付费用户，也感到被过度推销，考虑放弃Office，转向Libre Office和自建服务器存储方案。他希望能够支付较低的费用，使用一个无推送、简洁的旧版Office。

• [marcodiego] 和 [1970-01-01] 提到Office启动加速的问题，并将其与历史上的Windows加速启动技术（如Prefetch和Superfetch）相比较，认为这是旧技重施，而非新功能。

• [rappatic] 建议Windows可以在系统资源利用率低时后台加载Office，而不是在启动时加载，以避免拖慢系统启动速度。

• [everdrive] 则认为这种做法不会显著影响系统启动速度，且用户不会轻易尝试这种方法。

• [_--__--__] 提到Edge浏览器在关闭后仍会留下后台进程，认为这是微软让用户为其开发便利做出无意识的牺牲。

• [al_borland] 表示反对任何未经用户请求就自行启动的程序，认为这是对用户的不尊重，并会直接卸载此类程序。

• [cebert] 批评微软在进行ESG（环境、社会和治理）宣传的同时，没有关注其应用程序的低效对环境的影响。

• [jackconsidine] 分享了一个软件开发案例，客户希望通过延长加载时间来展示有趣的事实，以此提升用户体验，讽刺微软的某些设计决策。

• [gibibit] 提到MS Word加载大文档速度慢的问题，认为这是长期存在的缺点。

• [ghurtado] 认为微软这种做法早已众所周知，且自Windows 95以来就存在类似问题。

• [gerdesj] 指出Outlook是最大的启动加载违规者，并表示在本地Exchange环境中，Linux的Evolution性能优于Windows的Outlook。

• [geor9e] 表示只要未使用的RAM能立即释放，他并不介意系统在空闲时进行缓存预加载。

• [CuriousRose] 认为微软的开发决策对苹果公司来说是最好的市场宣传，因为微软的“好主意”反而让用户对苹果产品产生好感。

• [nine_k] 认为如果全天使用Office，预加载是有意义的，但如果不需要频繁使用，可以选择关闭预加载。同时质疑如果不用Office，为何还需要Windows系统，除非是为了玩不兼容Steamdeck的游戏。

补充讨论：用户对微软强制推送功能的反感，以及对软件性能和系统资源管理的关注是讨论中的重要主题。另外，历史技术与现代问题的类比也揭示了用户对微软产品长期存在的问题的不满。

43852162.article_content:
Home /
News /
Windows News
Image: Chris Hoffman / IDG
You know how every annoying Windows program wants to launch as soon as you boot up your computer? Well, now Office is going to do that, too. A new “Startup Boost” function will set Office to load when Windows starts up, which will make apps like Word and Excel launch faster—while making the rest of your computer slower. Whoopie.
I’m being flippant, but it’s understandable that Microsoft would want to give Office a performance boost, even if it is somewhat illusory. And in the company’s defense, the announcement in the
Microsoft 365 Message Center Archive
(spotted by
The Verge
) does say that the new tool will only be enabled on PCs that have at least 8GB of RAM and 5GB of free disk space. I think even trying to run Windows 11 on just 8GB of RAM is
kind of optimistic these days
, but at least there’s a floor.
A cynic might wonder why Microsoft is making Office start when the computer boots instead of, you know, just making Office more efficient so it can run faster. (There’s no second part to that statement. The cynic is me. I want Office to be more efficient.)
The update to the Microsoft 365 installer will initially only apply to Microsoft Word when it rolls out in mid-May, then spread to other Office programs later. And yes, you will be able to disable this feature. End users can turn it off in Word’s settings or in the Task Scheduler.
Author: Michael Crider
, Staff Writer, PCWorld
Michael is a 10-year veteran of technology journalism, covering everything from Apple to ZTE. On PCWorld he's the resident keyboard nut, always using a new one for a review and building a new mechanical board or expanding his desktop "battlestation" in his off hours. Michael's previous bylines include Android Police, Digital Trends, Wired, Lifehacker, and How-To Geek, and he's covered events like CES and Mobile World Congress live. Michael lives in Pennsylvania where he's always looking forward to his next kayaking trip.

data.author: shayneo
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Apple在App Store中的反竞争行为及其法律和财务问题

不同观点：
• **关于Apple反竞争行为的批评**：
  - [mil22] 提到Apple没有告知用户可以通过网站以更低价格购买订阅，导致用户困惑和不满。
  - [mrcwinn] 批评Apple以30%的佣金支持开发者生态系统的说法，认为这是不透明的，实际是为了维持高额收入。
  - [bze12] 指出Apple对外部支付处理器的高收费及对链接展示的严格限制，认为没有开发者会采用这种方案。
  - [thealexliang] 引用法院文件，强调Apple故意不遵守法院禁令，继续维持反竞争的收入流。

• **关于Apple内部决策的讨论**：
  - [xuki] 提到Tim Cook选择忽视Phil Schiller的建议，听从财务团队的意见，表明Cook对投资回报率的重视。
  - [snowwrestler] 对Phil Schiller被边缘化表示遗憾，认为他是Apple灵魂的一部分。

• **关于法律后果的讨论**：
  - [sensanaty] 质疑对Apple的罚款是否只是象征性的，担心大科技公司继续剥削用户。
  - [brudgers] 认为除非罚款接近万亿美元，否则对Apple没有实质影响。
  - [gamblor956] 强调法院将案件转交检察官进行刑事调查的意义重大。

• **关于用户体验和市场影响的讨论**：
  - [cuuupid] 询问Apple是否会放弃佣金或允许第三方应用商店在美国运营。
  - [yieldcrv] 认为iPhone用户习惯于在App Store进行购买，改变行为可能困难，但认为通过网站使用Apple Pay的体验也不错。

补充讨论：
• **关于Apple员工讨论吓退用户的设计**：
  - [dchest] 提到Apple员工在设计警告屏幕时，故意使用“外部网站”等词汇以吓退用户，这种行为被批评为不道德。

• **其他相关链接和资源**：
  - [flawn] 提供了一个存档链接。
  - [EcommerceFlow] 提到Tim Sweeney对Apple的持续抗争。
  - [lapcat] 提供了一个包含完整判决的非付费文章链接。

争议焦点：
• Apple是否故意不遵守法院禁令以维持反竞争的收入流。
• 对Apple的罚款是否足以产生实质性影响。
• Apple员工在设计用户警告屏幕时的动机和道德问题。

总结：评论主要围绕Apple在App Store中的反竞争行为及其法律和财务问题展开，批评者认为Apple通过不透明的高额佣金和限制外部支付处理器来维持其收入流，并对法院的判决和可能的罚款表示关注。同时，部分讨论涉及Apple内部决策过程及用户体验问题。

data.title: Zhaoxin's KX-7000
data.author: ryandotsmith
data.article_summary: Zhaoxin的KX-7000是一款基于“世纪大道”架构的最新x86 CPU，由VIA Technologies与上海市政合资企业设计，享有强大的x86-64软件生态和政府支持。KX-7000采用4宽度、支持AVX2的核心设计，具备与2010年代早期英特尔CPU类似的无序执行能力，目标是提升性能和时钟速度。该芯片拥有8个核心，共享32MB L3缓存，采用类似于AMD Ryzen的芯片布局。其前端设计相对传统，缺乏高级缓存和优化带宽，导致在处理复杂代码时性能受限。尽管分支预测和返回处理有所改进，但整体前端设计仍显简陋，缺乏现代CPU的一些高级特性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：中国兆芯（Zhaoxin）芯片的竞争力及其未来发展

不同观点：
• vessenes认为兆芯目前在性能上可以与2010/2011年代的AMD和Intel竞争，但内存速度存在一定问题。他还指出，兆芯参与非美国知识产权的竞赛以达到承载H100竞争AI硬件的水平是有意义的，目前可能还需要两次架构更新才能达到目标。

Zhaoxin is a Chinese x86 CPU designer. The KaiXian KX-7000 is Zhaoxin’s latest CPU, and features a new architecture dubbed “世纪大道”. 世纪大道 is a road in Shanghai called “Century Avenue”, following Zhaoxin’s practice of naming architectures after Shanghai landmarks. Zhaoxin is notable because it’s a joint venture between VIA Technologies and the Shanghai municipal government. It inherits VIA’s x86-64 license, and also enjoys powerful government backing. That’s a potent combination, because Zhaoxin’s cores are positioned to take advantage of the strong x86-64 software ecosystem.
x86-64 compatibility is just one part of the picture, because performance matters too. Zhaoxin’s previous LuJiaZui, implemented in the KX-6640MA, was clearly inadequate for handling modern applications. LuJiaZui was a 2-wide core with sub-3 GHz clock speeds and barely more reordering capacity than Intel’s Pentium II from 1997. Century Avenue takes aim at that performance problem.
Core Overview
Century Avenue is a 4-wide, AVX2 capable core with an out-of-order execution window on par with Intel CPUs from the early 2010s. Besides making the core wider and more latency-tolerant, Zhaoxin targets higher clock speeds. The KX-7000 runs at 3.2 GHz, significantly faster than the KX-6640MA’s 2.6 GHz. Zhaoxin’s site claims the KX-7000 can reach 3.5-3.7 GHz, but I never saw the chip clock above 3.2 GHz.
The KX-7000 has eight Century Avenue cores, and uses a chiplet setup reminiscent of single-CCD AMD Ryzen desktop parts. All eight cores sit on a die and share 32 MB of L3 cache. A second IO die connects to DRAM and other IO. Zhaoxin did not specify what process node they’re using.
Techpowerup
and
Wccftech
suggests it uses an unspecified 16nm node.
Frontend
At the frontend, instructions are fetched from a 64 KB 16-way instruction cache. The instruction cache can deliver 16 bytes per cycle, and feeds a 4-wide decoder. Century Avenue uses a thoroughly conventional frontend setup, without a loop buffer or op cache. Instruction cache bandwidth can therefore constrain frontend throughput if average instruction length exceeds 4 bytes.
Frontend bandwidth drops sharply as code spills out of L1i, creating another contrast with 2010s era western designs. Skylake for example can run code from L2 at over 12 bytes per cycle, adequate for >3 IPC with 4 byte instructions. Century Avenue suffers further if code spills into L3, where frontend bandwidth drops to under 4 bytes per cycle.
A 4096 entry branch target buffer (BTB) provides branch targets, and creates two pipeline bubbles after a taken branch. Taken branch latency jumps as the test spills out of L1i, even with far fewer than 4K branches. The BTB is likely tied to the L1i, and thus can’t be used to do long-distance prefetch past a L1i miss.
Century Avenue’s branching performance is reminiscent of older cores like VIA’s Nano. Dropping zero-bubble branching capability is a regression compared to LuJiaZui, which could do so from a small 16 entry L0 BTB. Perhaps Zhaoxin felt they couldn’t do zero-bubble branching at Century Avenue’s 3 GHz+ clock speed targets. However Intel and AMD CPUs from over a decade ago have faster branch target caching at higher clock speeds.
In Century Avenue’s favor, the direction predictor has vastly improved pattern recognition capabilities compared to its predecessor. When given repeating patterns of taken and not-taken branches, the KX-7000 handles a bit like Intel’s Sunny Cove.
Returns behave much like on LuJiaZui. Call+return pairs enjoy reasonable latency until they go more than four-deep. An inflection point further on suggests a second level return stack with approximately 32 entries. If there is a second level return stack, it’s rather slow with a cost of 14 cycles per call+return pair. Bulldozer shows more typical behavior. Call+return pairs are fast until they overflow a 24 entry return stack.
Century Avenue’s frontend aims to deliver up to four instructions per cycle with minimal sophistication. A conventional fetch and decode setup can be good if tuned properly, but Century Avenue’s frontend has a few clear weaknesses. Average instruction length can exceed 4 bytes in AVX2 code, thanks to VEX prefixes. AMD tackled this by increasing L1i bandwidth to 32B/cycle in 10h CPUs. Intel used loop buffers in Core 2 before introducing an op cache in Sandy Bridge (while keeping 16B/cycle L1i bandwidth). Either approach is fine, but Century Avenue does neither. Century Avenue also does not implement branch fusion, a technique that AMD and Intel have used for over a decade. An [add, add, cmp, jz] sequence executes at under 3 IPC.
Lack of sophistication extends to branch target caching. A single level BTB with effectively 3 cycle latency feels primitive today, especia
43850238.article_summary: Zhaoxin的KX-7000是一款基于“世纪大道”架构的最新x86 CPU，由VIA Technologies与上海市政合资企业设计，享有强大的x86-64软件生态和政府支持。KX-7000采用4宽度、支持AVX2的核心设计，具备与2010年代早期英特尔CPU类似的无序执行能力，目标是提升性能和时钟速度。该芯片拥有8个核心，共享32MB L3缓存，采用类似于AMD Ryzen的芯片布局。其前端设计相对传统，缺乏高级缓存和优化带宽，导致在处理复杂代码时性能受限。尽管分支预测和返回处理有所改进，但整体前端设计仍显简陋，缺乏现代CPU的一些高级特性。

data.title: Espressif's ESP32-C5 Is Now in Mass Production
data.author: radeeyate
data.article_summary: 2025年4月30日，乐鑫科技宣布其ESP32-C5芯片已进入量产阶段。ESP32-C5是业内首款支持2.4 GHz和5 GHz双频Wi-Fi 6以及蓝牙5 (LE) 和IEEE 802.15.4 (Zigbee, Thread) 的RISC-V SoC。该芯片搭载32位单核处理器，主频可达240 MHz，具备384 KB片上SRAM和外部PSRAM支持，320 KB ROM，最多29个可编程GPIO，支持常用外设和高速度接口如SDIO、QSPI，并提供一流的安全特性。ESP32-C5还包含一个主频高达40 MHz的LP-CPU，适用于功耗敏感应用。该芯片得到乐鑫成熟的物联网开发框架ESP-IDF支持，ESP-IDF v5.5将加入对ESP32-C5的初步支持。开发板已在乐鑫官方商城上架，详情可咨询乐鑫客户支持团队。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕ESP32-C5芯片的发布及其相关技术特性、价格、可用性、功耗和可编程性的讨论。

不同观点：
• [purpleidea] 认为开发者能够阻止用户对芯片进行重新编程是一个重大缺陷。尽管有安全性的考虑，但如果芯片在用户手中，用户应该能够通过硬件方式重新编程，以减少电子废物。
• [bri3d] 指出该芯片在发布和采样后经过了较长时间才正式推出，并强调5GHz支持的重要性。
• [Scene_Cast2] 关注功耗问题，认为nRF在功耗方面优于现有的ESP32变种。
• [stavros] 对ESP32-C5支持Zigbee表示欢迎，但同时表示对Espressif产品线的多样性感到困惑，寻求对比资源的建议。
• [TechDebtDevin] 担心由于关税问题导致芯片价格上涨，可能会对物联网业务造成影响，建议可能需要对某些Espressif产品进行关税豁免。

补充讨论：
• [winrid] 讨论了ESP32是否适合用于LoRa应用，并考虑转向STM32，但缺乏编程经验。
• [antoniuschan99] 期待P4芯片的发布。
• [gitroom] 对硬件锁定后是否能够更容易地修复或重新编程表示关注。
• [shoelessone] 询问何时能单独购买ESP32-C5模块，而无需购买开发板。
• [Tepix] 分享了以1.05欧元每个的价格购买ESP32-C3 Supermini板的经历，认为其性价比极高。
• [snvzz] 指出ESP32-C5使用RISC-V作为指令集架构（ISA）。
• [londons_explore] 询问10k单位价格是否公开。
• [winkywooster] 关心开发套件的内存容量，表示在链接文章中未找到明确信息。
• [platevoltage] 希望这次能支持USB Host HID类驱动，以支持非启动协议设备。
• [phkahler] 关注是否具有浮点硬件、CAN功能，并对新核心与旧核心的比较表示兴趣，尽管尚未使用过第二个核心。

争议焦点：
• ESP32-C5芯片的可编程性和开发者限制：[purpleidea]对开发者能够阻止用户重新编程表示不满，认为用户应有完全控制权，而[gitroom]则关注硬件锁定后的可修复性。
• 价格上涨的可能性：[TechDebtDevin]担心关税导致的价格上涨对物联网业务的影响，建议可能需要关税豁免。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 不同用户对ESP32-C5的应用场景和需求各异，例如[winrid]对LoRa应用的需求，[stavros]对Zigbee支持的关注，以及[phkahler]对具体技术细节的询问。
• 用户对ESP32-C5模块和开发板的可用性及购买渠道的关注，如[shoelessone]和[Tepix]的讨论。

Espressif's ESP32-C5 is Now in Mass Production
Shanghai,China
Apr 30, 2025
Today, we are glad to announce that ESP32-C5  is now in mass production.
Espressif Systems (SSE: 688018.SH) announced ESP32-C5, the industry’s first RISC-V SoC that supports 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz dual-band Wi-Fi 6, along with Bluetooth 5 (LE) and IEEE 802.15.4 (Zigbee, Thread) connectivity. Today, we are glad to announce that ESP32-C5  is now in mass production.
ESP32-C5 is designed for applications that require high-efficiency, low-latency wireless transmission. ESP32-C5 has a 32-bit single-core processor which can clock up to 240 MHz in speed. It has a 384 KB on-chip SRAM along with external PSRAM support, 320 KB of ROM. It has up to 29 programmable GPIOs, supporting all the commonly used peripherals, high speed interfaces like SDIO, QSPI, and the best-in-class security features. The ESP32-C5 also includes an LP-CPU running upto 40MHz which can act as the main processor for power sensitive applications. To learn more about the various capabilities and features of this MCU, please visit our
website
.
The ESP32-C5 benefits from software support provided by Espressif's well-established IoT development framework, ESP-IDF. The upcoming ESP-IDF v5.5, will include initial support for the ESP32-C5. For a detailed list of ESP-IDF features supported for the ESP32-C5,
click here
. The ESP32-C5 can also act as the connectivity coprocessor for external hosts using the
ESP-AT
or
ESP-Hosted
solutions.
ESP32-C5 development boards are now available for purchase at
Espressif's official stores
If you are interested in the ESP32-C5 series products, please contact our
customer support team
.

• ESP32-C5芯片的可编程性和开发者限制：[purpleidea]对开发者能够阻止用户重新编程表示不满，认为用户应有完全控制权，而[gitroom]则关注硬件锁定后的可修复性。

• 不同用户对ESP32-C5的应用场景和需求各异，例如[winrid]对LoRa应用的需求，[stavros]对Zigbee支持的关注，以及[phkahler]对具体技术细节的询问。
• 用户对ESP32-C5模块和开发板的可用性及购买渠道的关注，如[shoelessone]和[Tepix]的讨论。

data.title: The best – but not good – way to limit string length
data.author: adam-p
data.article_summary:
这篇文章深入探讨了字符串长度限制的复杂性，特别是在不同编程语言和字符编码中的实现差异。主要内容包括：

1. 不同方法计算字符串长度：如UTF-8字节、UTF-16代码单元、Unicode代码点和字素簇。
2. 理解编程语言如何在内存中存储和表示字符串，以及如何确定字符串长度。
3. 在限制字符串长度时，需明确选择计数方法，并在所有架构层次中保持一致。
4. 推荐按规范化的Unicode代码点计数来限制长度（如Google建议）。
5. 解释了字符、Unicode、代码点和字素簇等概念，并通过例子说明复杂性，如组合表情符号。

文章强调了在处理字符串长度时需要注意潜在的错误和安全风险。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：字符长度限制及字符编码处理的相关技术问题

不同观点：
• chrismorgan认为在处理文本区域（textarea）的字符长度时，客户端和服务器端对换行符的处理不一致（客户端是\n，服务器端是\r\n），导致长度验证问题，尤其是在"最大2000字符"的反馈表单中。
• wpollock建议不要在编程语言中使用字符类型，而是用字符串数组来处理字符，这样可以更方便地获取字符长度和字节大小，并推荐使用ICU库来处理Unicode，同时提到可以用Punycode来表示Unicode字符串为ASCII。
• jasonthorsness指出HTML输入属性如maxsize直接计算UTF-16代码单元，这对包含表情符号的字符串可能不适用。
• neuroelectron表示其网站将只支持ASCII编码，以避免上述复杂性。
• HeyImAlex表示该讨论对其很有帮助，解决了他长期以来的疑问。
• aidenn0认为讨论中未涉及字符串截断问题，并建议在需要截断时应在字形簇边界进行。

• o11c深入探讨了Unicode字符的规范化问题，并提出字符宽度计算的复杂性，特别是在不同字体下如何处理各种Unicode字符。
• bsder指出在最坏情况下，"20 UTF-8字节"可能仅相当于"1个印地语字符"，这需要特别注意。

43850398.article_content:
Getting the length of a string seems simple and is something we do in our code every day. Limiting the length of a string is also extremely common in both frontend and backend code. But both of those actions – especially length limiting – hide a lot of complexity, bug-risk, and even vulnerability danger. In this post, we’re going to examine string length limiting deeply enough to help us fully grok what it means when we do it and how best to do it… and discover that the best still isn’t great.
A TL;DR misses the “fully grok” part, but not everyone has time to read everything, so here are the key takeaways:
Be aware that there are different ways of measuring string length.
Really understand how your programming language stores strings in memory, exposes them to you, and determines string length.
Make an intentional decision about how you’re going to count characters when limiting string length.
Look carefully at how the “max length” features provided by your language (framework, etc.) actually work. There’s a very good chance that they do not match the limiting method you chose.
Make sure you use that same counting method across all the layers of your architecture.
Probably limit by counting normalized Unicode code points. (Like
Google recommends
.)
With that out of the way, let’s start our investigation by looking at some of our familiar string length functions:
“a”
“字”
“🔤”
“👨‍👩‍👧‍👦”
“र्स्प”
“x̴͙̹̬̑̓͝͝”
Go
len(string)
1
3
4
25
15
17
JavaScript
String.length
1
1
2
11
5
9
Python 3
len(str)
1
1
1
7
5
9
Swift
String.count
1
1
1
1
1
1
Those four measurements of string length are exemplars of the approaches common to most programming languages: UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 code units, Unicode code points, and grapheme clusters.
##
Character encodings and terminology
There are
good explanations
of this stuff elsewhere, but let’s try to quickly get a handle on the concepts we need to go further. (Feel free to skip anything you’re already comfortable with.)
First, a working definition of a “
character
”: This is the human conceptual ideal of the smallest building block of most written languages
1
: a letter, an emoji, an ideograph, a punctuation mark, a symbol, a grapheme. Later on we’ll also think of a character as “if a user types this, they expect a ‘character count’ to increase by 1”. All of the examples in the above table probably look like “a character” to you.
(We’re going to avoid using this term lightly, in favour of technical correctness, to avoid confusion. So I’m never going to say “Unicode character”.)
###
Unicode
Unicode
is humanity’s attempt to list all possible characters, plus a whole lot more: control characters, non-printable characters, fragments that can be combined to form characters, and so on.
Each entry in the Unicode space is called a “
code point
” and is represented with a 32-bit unsigned integer, though the actual usable space is only 2²¹ (1.1 million possible values) and only about 150,000 of those values have been assigned. You might also see the term “
Unicode scalar units
” – these are basically the same as code points, but exclude the reserved “surrogate pair” range.
Examples (character: code, decimal)
“a”:
U+0061
, 97
“字”:
U+5B57
, 23383
“🔤”:
U+1F524
, 128292
Strictly speaking, a “Unicode code point” is an abstract concept, with a numerical value assigned to each character. There are 3 common concrete schemes for encoding those code points: UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32. “
UTF-32
” is a direct representation: 32 bits to encode the 32 bits, with endian variants. I’m going to prefer just saying “Unicode code point” for clarity. We’ll discuss UTF-8 and UTF-16 at length below.
Note that in Go, a Unicode code point is typically called a “
rune
”. (Go
seems to have
introduced the term for the sake of brevity. I certainly appreciate that, but I’m going to stick with universal terms here.)
###
Grapheme cluster
Some Unicode code points can be combined and rendered into a single visual character; we call this a
grapheme cluster
(or extended grapheme cluster).
We’ll go through some examples, to help illuminate the complexity.
“👨‍👩‍👧‍👦”: composed of 7 code points
“👨”:
U+1F468
, “man”
zero-width joiner:
U+200D
, HTML entity
‍
“👩”:
U+1F469
, “woman”
zero-width joiner:
U+200D
, HTML entity
‍
“👧”:
U+1F467
, “girl”
zero-width joiner:
U+200D
, HTML entity
‍
“👦”:
U+1F466
, “boy”
The family emoji is an example of a “zero-width joiner (ZWJ) sequence”.
Not all possible combinations of emoji (or code points generally) can be combined in such a way to create a single grapheme cluster character. The Unicode consortium
publishes
all defined emoji, including multi-code-point compounds.
Whether and how an emoji is rendered depends on the platform you’re viewing it on. For example, here is what the family emoji looks like in Brave browser on Windows –
– versus on Android –
.
And rendering can change over time. In 2014, with Windows 10, Microsoft introduced the
“ninjacat”
ZWJ sequence emoji, combining the “cat”

data.title: Republicans in Congress Want a Flat $200 Annual EV Tax
data.author: m463
data.article_summary: 美国众议院交通与基础设施委员会即将讨论其预算立法提案，其中包含对电动车和混合动力车的新年度注册费用。根据该提案，纯电动车将需支付200美元的年费，混合动力车则需支付100美元，而柴油车等高排放车辆的费用较低，且2030年前无需付费。费用将随通胀逐年增加，直至2034年或2035年到期。尽管该法案旨在填补高速公路信托基金的资金缺口，但由于对电动车的高额收费可能抑制其普及，且商业车辆和农用车辆获得豁免，实际效果受到质疑。环保组织批评该提案惩罚了清洁能源车辆驾驶者，而非解决信托基金的根本问题。

WASHINGTON, DC—The House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee will meet today to discuss its proposed budget legislation, and there's a doozy in there for drivers of electric vehicles and hybrids. As part of the Republican Party's ongoing war against
science
and
the environment
under President Trump, committee chairperson Sam Graves (R-Mo.) has included some new annual fees that will cost all drivers some, but some drivers more.
Republicans plan to use the
budget reconciliation process
to pass this legislation, which is an expedited process that removes some of the US Senate's ability to stall. They're proposing a new annual federal motor vehicle registration fee, which state DMVs would have to collect and pass back to the federal government.
If it passes, all battery EVs would be subject to a new $200 tax. Hybrids—defined as vehicles that are propelled by both an electric motor and an internal combustion engine or other power source (which would include fuel cell EVs)—will pay $100. But someone who commutes 90 miles a day in a particulate-belching Ford F-350 Duramax diesel pickup truck gets away with a mere $20 a year, and only from October 1, 2030; until then they get to drive for free.
To make things even better, the bill requires these fees to be linked to inflation and should be increased each year, until 2034 when the tax expires for unelectrified vehicles, or 2035, the last year that EVs and hybrids would be taxed like this. So, a $200 registration fee in 2026 becomes a $250 registration fee in 2035.
Not everyone will have to pay, however. The bill exempts commercial vehicles, which should see a rush from tax avoiders to register their vehicles under their businesses, similar to what we saw during the George W. Bush administration, when a change in the tax law meant businesses
could claim a $100,000 tax credit
if they purchased a truck or SUV that weighed more than 6,000 lbs. Farm vehicles are also exempt from the law.
With EV adoption as low as it is in the US, the sums raised by these EV and hybrid charges will be essentially a rounding error in the federal budget, which this year should top $7 trillion. The Eno Center for Transportation calculates that this new tax will contribute an extra $110 billion to the highway Trust Fund by 2035 but that cuts to other taxes and more spending mean that the fund will still be $222 billion short of its commitments—assuming that this added fee doesn't further dampen EV adoption in the US, that is.
The committee cannot mandate that states collect these new taxes on drivers. But just as the federal government used the withholding of federal highway funds as a stick to force all states to raise the drinking age to 21, this bill would require the Department of Transportation to withhold 125 percent of the estimated total registration fees if it did not comply.
Graves' justification for this regressive attack on clean energy policies is that it's merely a matter of fairness, with a healthy side helping of the usual grievance politics. "Our proposal more than offsets these historic investments and reduces the deficit with rescissions of wasteful Green New Deal style spending from the Inflation Reduction Act and ensuring that electric vehicles begin paying their share for their use of the nation’s highways. It’s only fair that EVs pay these user fees like other motorists. In fact, the new user fees provision addresses the broken Highway Trust Fund revenue stream in a substantial manner for the first time in over 30 years," Graves said in a statement.
Making this move even more regressive, Graves notes in his statement that the vast majority of US states—39 in total—already charge
EV drivers a registration fee
, and 28 do the same for hybrid drivers. Graves also hints at the end of a federal gasoline tax, despite
ever-increasing levels of atmospheric CO
2
and the unequivocal evidence that this is caused by fossil fuel emissions.
"House Republicans are threatening to take away billions of dollars in funding that will help to slash health-threatening pollution, improve walkability, and rebuild communities harmed by highways," said Katherine Garcia, director of Sierra Club Clean Transportation for All.
"They're also trying to punish EV and hybrid drivers with an excessive annual fee rather than fixing the unsustainable Highway Trust Fund. Now is the time to incentivize, not penalize, people to drive cleaner vehicles that curb pollution harmful to our health and climate. Rather than spreading misinformation and attacking popular programs, Congress must focus on ensuring more Americans have access to clean transportation options. This proposal to shift critical funding and impose a punitive fee on Americans to pay for billionaire tax cuts is unacceptable."
Jonathan M. Gitlin

data.title: I Found Malware in a BeamNG Mod
data.author: davikr
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了作者在BeamNG.drive游戏中的一款模组（American Road）中发现了恶意软件。起初，作者在启动游戏时收到防病毒软件的警告，提示有可疑的`curl.exe`活动。通过使用Process Monitor和WinDbg等工具，作者确认了问题源自游戏内的模组管理器，并追踪到模组"American Road"中的可疑JavaScript代码。该代码试图加载一个不存在的"banner.c_css"文件，并使用了不必要的XMLHttpRequest。进一步分析发现，该代码利用了Chromium Embedded Framework的漏洞，将shellcode注入内存，执行恶意命令。最终，作者通过逐一启用模组，确认了"American Road"模组是问题来源，并提醒用户小心此类恶意模组。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：BeamNG和BeamMP项目中的安全问题，尤其是与模组（mods）相关的潜在恶意代码和安全漏洞。

Do not run any of the code in this post outside of a secure, isolated virtual machine.
Last week, I fired up
BeamNG.drive
hoping to enjoy a ride around Belasco City.
But, just after I launched the game, I noticed an odd notification from my antivirus software.
curl.exe
? That can’t be good.
Cloudflare Radar
confirmed
the domain

At this point, however, I wasn’t 100% sure this came from the game.
Starting the investigation
To find out if the problem was indeed in the game, I re-launched it with
Process Monitor
running.
Filtering through the events, my suspicion was confirmed: a process launching
cmd
with a
curl
command was spawned by the game.
But where exactly was this command coming from? Was it a mod, or was the game itself compromised?
Inspecting the call stack in Process Monitor shows the command was executed by calling
WinExec
, a legacy function from 16-bit Windows that is commonly used in shellcode malware.
To take a closer look, I attached the
WinDbg
debugger to the game process and set a breakpoint on
WinExec
.
When the malicious code tries to run the command, the debugger will pause the process and allow me to inspect the call stack and memory.
That breakpoint was hit at the exact moment I opened the in-game mod manager.
WinDbg shows which memory address

was called at, and we can use that to find the shellcode that executed the command.
But how did this shellcode even get there in the first place?
Unfortunately, the call stack doesn’t show us which file it came from, but it does contain another clue:
libcef
.
This refers to the
Chromium Embedded Framework
, which suggests a vulnerability in Chromium might have been exploited to insert the shellcode into memory.
BeamNG.drive uses Chromium to render parts of the UI, including the mod manager where the malicious code was executed.
I disabled all my downloaded mods and dug deeper.
The mod

When I previously played the game 2 months ago, there was nothing suspicious.
The malicious command was spawned when I opened the in-game mod manager.
Disabling all mods stopped the suspicious event from appearing.

data.title: Windows RDP lets you log-in using revoked passwords. Microsoft is ok with that
data.author: drpixie
data.article_summary: 微软表示，不计划修改Windows中的远程登录协议，该协议允许用户在更改密码后仍能使用已撤销的密码进行远程登录。这一设计决策旨在确保用户不会被锁定，即使系统长时间离线，至少一个用户账户始终能登录。独立安全研究员Daniel Wade指出，这一行为违背了用户的普遍预期，即更改密码应切断所有关联设备的访问权限。旧密码可通过RDP持续访问机器，绕过云验证和多因素认证。微软认为这不构成安全漏洞，不会进行修改。这一问题源于本地存储的凭证缓存机制，可能导致安全风险，尤其是在账户凭证泄露的情况下。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：微软Windows系统中缓存的离线凭据行为是否是设计缺陷或安全问题

不同观点：
• Someone1234：认为这不是一个bug，而是一个设计决策。离线访问功能在某些情况下至关重要，尤其是在无法配置网络的情况下。尽管改进措施可能会受到批评，微软仍应尝试改进，比如定期与AD或Microsoft登录验证离线凭据。虽然这些改进并非绝对安全，但仍是“尽力而为”的提升。

• kryogen1c：认为缓存的本地凭据和保存的远程桌面协议（RDP）凭据长期存在，且可以通过组策略（GPO）设置进行管理。质疑讨论者是否在工作组环境中测试而非域环境，并指出如果时间过长，缓存的凭据将失效。

• gerdesj：对讨论内容持怀疑态度，认为RDP密码经过加密和加盐处理，除非在ADUC中勾选特定选项，否则不会以明文存储。质疑微软声明“设计决策确保至少一个用户账户始终能够登录”的真正含义。

• photon_rancher：确认在Windows AD登录中，若在脱机状态下更改密码，旧密码仍可使用。如果恢复网络连接，系统可能会接受旧密码，但输入错误密码会触发域检查，导致登录窗口挂起。虽然行为不理想，但可能在域设置中可配置。

• notnmeyer：认为这种行为是不可接受的，表示震惊和反对。

• politelemon：个人经验表明在企业域环境中无法利用这种行为，访问被拒绝。

补充讨论：
• Someone1234提到UAC作为类似例子，指出这种改进并非真正的安全边界，但仍是“尽力而为”的提升。
• kryogen1c暗示讨论者可能在寻求bug bounty（漏洞赏金），并提到无缓存需要always-on VPN等设置。
• gerdesj提到自己主要使用Linux，对Windows中的此类问题感到厌烦。
• photon_rancher详细描述了在线和离线状态下密码验证的行为差异，并指出域同步速度慢可能导致登录体验差。

争议焦点：
• 核心争议在于微软的离线凭据行为是否是一个设计缺陷，还是为了确保可用性的必要设计决策。有人认为这是不可接受的安全风险，而另一些人则认为在某些情况下这是必要的功能。

From the department of head scratches comes this counterintuitive news: Microsoft says it has no plans to change a remote login protocol in Windows that allows people to log in to machines using passwords that have been revoked.
Password changes are among the first steps people should take in the event that a password has been leaked or an account has been compromised. People expect that once they've taken this step, none of the devices that relied on the password can be accessed.
Not just a bug
The
Remote Desktop Protocol
—the proprietary mechanism built into Windows for allowing a remote user to log in to and control a machine as if they were directly in front of it—however, will in many cases continue trusting a password even after a user has changed it. Microsoft says the behavior is a design decision to ensure users never get locked out.
Independent security researcher Daniel Wade reported the behavior earlier this month to the Microsoft Security Response Center. In the report, he provided step-by-step instructions for reproducing the behavior. He went on to warn that the design defies nearly universal expectations that once a password has been changed, it can no longer give access to any devices or accounts associated with it.
“This Isn’t Just a Bug. It’s a Trust Breakdown,” Wade wrote in his report. “People trust that changing their password will cut off unauthorized access.” He continued:
It’s the first thing anyone does after suspecting compromise. And yet:
Old credentials continue working for RDP—even from brand-new machines.
Defender, Entra ID, and Azure don’t raise any flags.
There is no clear way for end-users to detect or fix the issue.
No Microsoft documentation or guidance addresses this scenario directly.
Even newer passwords may be ignored while older ones continue to function.
The result? Millions of users—at home, in small businesses, or hybrid work setups—are unknowingly at risk.
In response, Microsoft said the behavior is a “a design decision to ensure that at least one user account always has the ability to log in no matter how long a system has been offline.” As such, Microsoft said the behavior doesn’t meet the definition of a security vulnerability, and company engineers have no plans to change it.
The ability to use a revoked password to log in through RDP occurs when a Windows machine that’s signed in with a Microsoft or Azure account is configured to enable remote desktop access. In that case, users can log in over RDP with a dedicated password that’s validated against a locally stored credential. Alternatively, users can log in using the credentials for the online account that was used to sign in to the machine.
A screenshot of an RDP configuration window showing a Microsoft account (for Hotmail) has remote access.
Even after users change their account password, however, it remains valid for RDP logins indefinitely. In some cases, Wade reported, multiple older passwords will work while newer ones won’t. The result: persistent RDP access that bypasses cloud verification, multifactor authentication, and Conditional Access policies.
Wade and another expert in Windows security said that the little-known behavior could prove costly in scenarios where a Microsoft or Azure account has been compromised, for instance when the passwords for them have been publicly leaked. In such an event, the first course of action is to change the password to prevent an adversary from using it to access sensitive resources. While the password change prevents the adversary from logging in to the Microsoft or Azure account, the old password will give an adversary access to the user’s machine through RDP indefinitely.
“This creates a silent, remote backdoor into any system where the password was ever cached,” Wade wrote in his report. “Even if the attacker never had access to that system, Windows will still trust the password.”
Will Dormann, a senior vulnerability analyst at security firm Analygence, agreed.
"It doesn't make sense from a security perspective," he wrote in an online interview. "If I'm a sysadmin, I'd expect that the moment I change the password of an account, then that account's old credentials cannot be used anywhere. But this is not the case."
Credential caching is a problem
The mechanism that makes all of this possible is credential caching on the hard drive of the local machine. The first time a user logs in using Microsoft or Azure account credentials, RDP will confirm the password's validity online. Windows then stores the credential in a cryptographically secured format on the local machine. From then on, Windows will validate any password entered during an RDP login by comparing it against the locally stored credential, with no online lookup. With that, the revoked password will still give remote access through RDP.

data.author: freemanjiang
data.article_summary: Beatsync 是一个高精度的网页音频播放器，支持多设备同步播放和空间音频效果。其主要特点包括毫秒级同步精度、跨平台兼容（现代浏览器均可使用，Chrome 效果最佳）、空间音频控制及精美的用户界面。项目支持自托管，并提供了快速启动指南。目前处于早期开发阶段，移动端支持正在实验中。技术上使用 Turborepo 管理，包含 Bun 服务器、Next.js 前端和共享的 Type-safe 代码。项目代码基于 MIT 协议开源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：多设备音频同步技术的实现和应用

不同观点：
• whimsy认为该技术在家庭和聚会场景中都有很大的应用潜力。家庭应用中，可以通过服务器调整每个客户端的音频输出，以实现最佳音效，尤其是在多声道音响系统中。聚会场景中，希望设备能够自动定位并调整同步，实现移动中的音频同步，但这一点可能需要硬件支持。同时还提出了对铜缆和光缆延迟的考虑。
• freemanjiang强调该技术最初为面对面的群体聆听设计，但由于只需要浏览器即可工作，因此也可以跨互联网使用，让远距离的多人同步聆听同一音频。
• Krei-se建议使用RTP与PulseAudio结合，可以天然解决设备间的延迟同步问题，无需额外软件。
• daredoes提到Snapcast是当前用于全屋音频同步的解决方案，并愿意尝试其他替代方案。
• thruflo分享了其他类似的项目以供参考，如Strobe.audio和Panaudia。
• dchristian提醒注意专利问题，提到了Sonos和Google之间的音频同步技术争议。
• TowerTall分享了一个实际的历史例子，说明这种技术在过去可能带来的便利。
• Dwedit和fxtentacle关注音频缓冲区和设备时钟速率差异的处理问题。
• matteason表示对该技术在其自身项目中的应用感兴趣，并希望借鉴其中的技术。
• chaosprint提出了使用WebTransport的建议，并关注网络抖动和系统级音频输出延迟的差异对同步的影响。
• Groxx对该技术在不同设备和浏览器间的准确性表示赞赏。
• maxmynter95提到多设备播放时可能出现的轻微延迟，产生类似混响的效果。
• rezonant指出该项目尚未选定开源许可证，因此严格来说只是源码可见而非开源。
• lacoolj对该技术的潜力表示兴奋，但对目前仅优化特定平台表示失望，期待跨平台的改进。

补充讨论：
• 技术实现上，涉及了设备自动定位、音频缓冲区管理、时钟速率差异、网络抖动和系统延迟等问题。
• 应用场景包括家庭音响系统、聚会音频同步、跨互联网同步聆听等。
• 专利和开源许可证问题也被提及，显示出对法律和许可方面的关注。
• 不同用户对平台适用性和优化程度的反馈，表明了跨平台兼容性的重要性。

Beatsync
Beatsync is a high-precision web audio player built for multi-device playback. The official app is
beatsync.gg
.
beatsync-demo.mov
Features
Millisecond-accurate synchronization
: Abstracts
NTP-inspired
time synchronization primitives to achieve a high degree of accuracy
Cross-platform
: Works on any device with a modern browser (Chrome recommended for best performance)
Spatial audio:
Allows controlling device volumes through a virtual listening source for interesting sonic effects
Polished interface
: Smooth loading states, status indicators, and all UI elements come built-in
Self-hostable
: Run your own instance with a few commands
Note
Beatsync is in early development. Mobile support is working, but experimental. Please consider creating an issue or contributing with a PR if you run into problems!
Quickstart
This project uses
Turborepo
.
Fill in the
.env
file in
apps/client
with the following:
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8080
NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://localhost:8080/ws
Run the following commands to start the server and client:
bun install
#
installs once for all workspaces
bun dev
#
starts both client (:3000) and server (:8080)

data.title: Ukraine Is Turning to 18th Century Tech for Defense
data.author: purpleko
data.article_summary: 乌克兰正在利用18世纪的技术——飞艇，来增强其防御能力，尤其是在对抗无人机方面。这些飞艇配备了现代传感器和摄像设备，能够有效监测和干扰敌方无人机。由于飞艇具有滞空时间长、覆盖范围广的优势，它们为乌克兰提供了持续的空中监视能力，提升了反无人机作战的效率。这一创新结合了古老技术与现代科技，展示了在当前冲突中的独特应用价值。文章由专注于航空航天和国防技术的记者Tereza Pultarova撰写。
